description: This file is a shell script used for testing quoting and filename handling in a Git repository. It sets up files with various special characters and encodes their expected output in different formats, executing Git commands to verify the correct handling of filenames with quotes, tabs, newlines, and non-ASCII characters.

methods.name: for_each_name
methods.description: Iterates over a set of filename examples, executing a provided command for each name to create or manipulate files with diverse naming conventions, including special characters and Unicode.
